name: Pocket Expenses - Bank SMS Auto-Tracking & Biometrics Knowledge Graph
description: Knowledge graph tracking the architecture, components, flows, and Android native bridge for auto-tracking expenses & income from bank SMS messages, organized by date.

communities.name: Mobile UI & Review Flow
communities.description: Components and pages delivering the user interface on Android APK.

communities.name: SMS Engine & Parsing
communities.description: Bilingual (AR/EN) SMS normalization, amount/currency extraction, balance separation, and date grouping.

communities.name: Android Native & Capacitor Bridge
communities.description: Android permissions, Telephony BroadcastReceiver, and Capacitor plugin.

communities.name: Data Models & Storage
communities.description: Supabase database operations, domain types, and data hooks.

nodes.label: Mobile Page
nodes.description: Primary mobile view for standalone APK. Listens to incoming SMS, fetches background queued SMS, shows alerts, and manages expenses and income.

nodes.label: BankSmsTrackerModal
nodes.description: Modal interface for reviewing pending bank transactions grouped by date, scanning all device SMS messages, toggling auto-save vs review, and testing SMS parser.

nodes.label: SMS Parser Engine
nodes.description: Parses English and Arabic bank SMS. Normalizes numerals, extracts amounts without balance interference, currencies, merchants, DD/MM dates, and matches categories.

nodes.label: Bank SMS Bridge
nodes.description: TypeScript client bridge to Capacitor BankSms plugin, managing user preferences, deduplication storage, date-sorted transactions, and background queues.

nodes.label: SMS Parser Tests
nodes.description: Automated node:test suite verifying bank SMS formats (Jordanian CliQ, Uncle Osaka card debit, account credits, Etihad, Arab Bank, Manaseer, OTP filtering).

nodes.label: AndroidManifest.xml
nodes.description: Declares RECEIVE_SMS, READ_SMS, USE_BIOMETRIC permissions, widget receivers, and SmsBroadcastReceiver.

nodes.label: SmsBroadcastReceiver
nodes.description: Listens for Telephony.SMS_RECEIVED broadcast. Persists unhandled messages in SharedPreferences and notifies plugin.

nodes.label: BankSmsPlugin
nodes.description: Capacitor Plugin handling permission requests, content://sms/inbox scanning (all messages or date-filtered), and dispatching real-time smsReceived events.

nodes.label: MainActivity
nodes.description: Native Android entrypoint registering BankSmsPlugin, ExpenseWidgetPlugin, and BiometricAuthPlugin with the Capacitor bridge.

nodes.label: useExpenses Hook
nodes.description: Data management hook querying and inserting expenses into Supabase with account_type bank.

nodes.label: useIncome Hook
nodes.description: Data management hook querying and inserting income/credits into Supabase with account_type bank.

nodes.label: useCategories Hook
nodes.description: Fetches household categories used for category auto-detection in SMS transactions.

nodes.label: Domain Types
nodes.description: Core TypeScript interfaces: Expense, Income, Category, Visibility, AccountType.

nodes.label: Build APK Script
nodes.description: Builds, signs, and outputs pocket-expenses.apk into artifacts/ directory.
